# Extended results

*Generated by `scripts/make_results_page.py` from `results/results.csv` (145 evaluation runs) and `results/results_extended.csv` (113 runs with the full metric set). All MAE values are in percentage points of SOC.*


## 1. Label efficiency, with seed spread

Mean over all available repeats; the parenthesised value is the standard deviation across label subsets and initialisations where more than one run exists. The generic 7-channel encoders are the controlled comparison; the re-implemented published architectures use their original I, V, T inputs.

| Model | 100 % | 25 % | 10 % | 5 % | 1 % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ReBoot (Coulomb pairing + mask, 200 ep.) | 0.436 (0.003) | 0.519 (0.004) | 0.562 (0.002) | 0.614 (0.003) | 0.773 (0.004) |
| ReBoot (position pairing, 200 ep.) | 0.393 | 0.478 | 0.536 | 0.600 | 0.813 |
| ReBoot (100 ep., ablation reference) | 0.438 | — | — | — | 0.781 |
| Masked reconstruction only (100 ep.) | 0.425 | 0.527 | 0.602 | 0.670 | 0.864 |
| SimCLR-style (100 ep.) | 0.424 | 0.531 | 0.601 | 0.669 | 0.922 |

| TCN, from scratch | 0.369 | 0.513 | 0.658 | 0.810 | 1.208 |
| Transformer (generic), from scratch | 0.766 | 0.667 | 0.637 | 0.727 | 1.099 |

## 2. Raw-input control (encoder sees only I, V, T, Δt)

| Model | 100 % | 25 % | 10 % | 5 % | 1 % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ReBoot (100 ep.) | 0.890 | 0.943 | 1.008 | 1.074 | 1.313 |
| Hybrid, from scratch | 1.141 | 1.068 | 1.139 | 1.275 | 1.713 |
| **relative change** | **-22 %** | **-12 %** | **-11 %** | **-16 %** | **-23 %** |

Pretraining helps at every label fraction once the derived channels are removed from the encoder input, which is the cleanest statement of its contribution.

## 4. Ablations and sweeps (100-epoch pretraining)

| Variant | 100 % | 1 % |
|---|---|---|
| Full ReBoot, 100 ep. | 0.438 | 0.781 |
| − L_refl | 0.444 | 0.921 |
| − L_ord | 0.436 | 0.798 |
| − L_phys | 0.414 | 0.817 |
| Single latent | 0.450 | 0.758 |
| L_mask only | 0.425 | 0.864 |
| SimCLR-style | 0.424 | 0.922 |
| λ_refl = 0.1 (default 0.5) | 0.439 | 0.750 |
| λ_refl = 2.0 | 0.438 | 0.769 |
| λ_phys = 0  | 0.422 | 0.831 |
| λ_phys = 0.001 | — | 0.815 |
| λ_phys = 0.1 | 0.732 | 0.952 |
| λ_phys = 1.0 | 1.706 | 1.700 |
| unlabelled pool 10 % | 0.452 | 0.899 |
| unlabelled pool 25 % | 0.441 | 0.820 |
| unlabelled pool 50 % | 0.437 | 0.794 |
| Linear probe (encoder frozen) | 0.850 | 1.199 |
| Full ReBoot, 200 ep. | 0.436 | 0.773 |

`λ_phys` is the clearest knob: the published 0.01 is near optimal at 1 % labels, and raising it to 1.0 degrades both regimes by a factor of two — the physics term is a weak constraint, not a second objective. Shrinking the unlabelled pool to 10 % of the cycles costs more at 1 % labels than at 100 %, as a pretraining effect should.


## 5. Distribution shift

| Protocol | labels | ReBoot | same encoder, from scratch |
|---|---|---|---|
| cross-battery (cells 7, 11, 19 held out) | 100 % | 1.002 | 1.022 |
| cross-battery (cells 7, 11, 19 held out) | 5 % | 1.027 | 0.956 |
| cross-battery (cells 7, 11, 19 held out) | 1 % | 1.052 | 1.131 |
| cross-cycle (final 30 % of each cell's life) | 100 % | 5.532 | 5.454 |

ReBoot neither helps nor hurts materially under shift. The paper reports this as a limitation rather than a result.


## 6. Model size and inference throughput

| Model | parameters | windows / s (1× A100) |
|---|---|---|
| ReBoot 200 ep. | 811,016 | 48,692 |
| Masked recon. only | 811,016 | 50,281 |
| SimCLR-style | 811,016 | 49,948 |
| Hybrid, from scratch | 333,697 | 47,809 |
| TCN, from scratch | 167,297 | 50,339 |
| Transformer [7] | 613,121 | 45,493 |
| LSTM [4] | 153,345 | 53,429 |

ReBoot adds no inference cost over the encoder it is built on: pretraining changes the weights, not the architecture. The decoder and the two projection heads are discarded after Stage 1.
